summary: Add non-disclosing macOS Keychain credential access
description: Prerequisites: T001-contracts. Add explicit setup and retrieval boundaries for one Todoist generic-password item; tokens never appear in argv, tracked config, output, exceptions, or state.
acceptance: Credential setup reads the secret without command-line disclosure and stores it in a named macOS Keychain service.
Retrieval, missing-item, subprocess-failure, and redaction tests never expose secret bytes.
